reform_contract._comment: W1's runner (policyengine.py#577); its pass also needs policyengine-uk#2305 and policyengine.py#575, so certified 2.125.1 fails the dated cases by design.

tool._comment: W3's aggregate-impact tool, pinned so both pairs use the same definitions (draft policyengine-uk#2335). Move the pin to the merged commit when it lands.

reform_responsiveness._comment: Plan invariant 'Reform responsiveness' (11 Oct 2026): a reform the model silently ignores must fail qualification. The standard set, each reform's target variable, direction and yearly minimum are the metrics tool's own (standard_reforms.yaml in the pinned tool; the minimums are W3's proposals pending cos d1344). The tool costs the set by default and emits reform_runs:<id> and responsive:<id> checks. This gate requires both checks to be present and passing for every standard reform in the candidate's report, and recomputes each responsive verdict from the report's reform_targets.<id> values.

promotion.decision: cos d1344: automatic promotion and review bounds are methodology calls; until ruled, promotion is a reviewed PR merge.
